_readme: Legal-page SEO meta, 12 locales. Read at RUNTIME by src/lib/pageSeo.ts (getPageSeo) and at BUILD by scripts/generate-prerender-meta.mjs, so prerendered shells match the client render per locale. Titles are the SHORT form (no brand): PageSeo.tsx appends ' | LaplandNightlife' at runtime and the generator appends the same suffix when emitting prerender-meta.json.
